snippet.title: A Tale of Body Limbs - Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for a point-and-click video game inspired by the life and death of Mary and Percy Shelley. 

You can find the game on itch: 
https://vani-bunny.itch.io/a-tale-of-body-limbs
